title: Orchestrator mode uses agent files because modelPicker rows take one model
what: Claude Code modelPicker rows accept a single model string (no pair, agent, or effort) and mods have no model-picker event, so the pair lives in .claude/agents frontmatter
why: User wanted an Antigravity-like Orchestrator option
learned: Verified on CLI 2.1.296: the agent model and disallowedTools apply to the main thread via --agent and via the agent key in settings.local.json
author: reactive-end
